_about: Judgments for the RELATED section of graph_rag_search (make ask): does the
graph arm surface the expected article from a graph-connected document the
direct top hits missed? Anchored by DOC-ID REGEX + HEADING REGEX, never by
chunk_id (chunk ids are positional) and never by rank (the related section
is grouped by document score, and document scores shift when the relation
weight ontology is tuned -- membership is the contract, order is not).
A judgment scores only when the expected document is NOT a seed doc: the
related section excludes seed docs by design, so a corpus or embedder
change that promotes the document into the seeds reports as `absorbed`
(excluded from the mean, counted separately) rather than as a miss.
Every row was recorded from a measurement against a built index, per the
repo rule that retrieval changes are measurements, not opinions.

queries.why: Direct top-5 carries the 예치금 articles of two bills; the co-citation arm must surface the SAME concept's article in the bills the direct list missed.
제103조(자산연동형…자격요건) is the README's canonical synonym-gap miss; the graph arm must reach it through the shared-statute pivot when 01 is not a seed.
The cross-bill family case: every bill legislates 검사/처분; related must extend the family beyond the direct top hits.
03's enforcement articles are reachable only through the graph when its bill is absent from the direct top-5.
